summary: Presents example use cases for DDoS Open Threat Signaling (DOTS), which aims to let different DDoS mitigation systems interoperate. The use cases describe how DOTS components interact, how they collaborate and what typical information they exchange. It is informational.

eli5.summary: When a website is flooded with junk traffic, it needs to call for help from defenders. This document gives example stories of who calls whom and what they say, so the call-for-help system can be designed.

questions: how does ddos signaling work between components
